thesis: The speakers introduce the 'Piton Network' as a mental model describing how a single business decision simultaneously supports and constrains other decisions, creating a cluster of interdependent choices. Using Southwest Airlines as a case study, they argue that the company's strategy relies on optimizing all decisions toward a singular goal of maximizing plane time in the air and full capacity, noting that deviating from this focus disrupts the entire system.
